sql: SELECT '+' AS label WHERE '+' NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT m.label FROM molecule m JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id WHERE a.element = 'Sn' AND m.label IS NOT NULL) UNION ALL SELECT '-' AS label WHERE '-' NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT m.label FROM molecule m JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id WHERE a.element = 'Sn' AND m.label IS NOT NULL)
